mathematical_checks.subject: Singh exit stopping and crossing
mathematical_checks.details: The minimum of the exit and Green-martingale threshold times is bounded deterministically by CR^(d+1), before any assumption that exit is finite. Stopped local times bound brackets by CR log R; maximal Freedman excludes the auxiliary stop. Contact plus crossing gives a filled ball of radius cR and the lower exit clock. The shorter directional crossing proof retains the original deterministic hypotheses.

mathematical_checks.subject: Squared-Green identity
mathematical_checks.details: Checked the normalized Dirichlet energy, factor 2d in the variance bound, coefficient 2(gamma-g(0)) times local time, and the positive sign of the first-departure drift sum in the exact Dynkin identity.

mathematical_checks.subject: Self-normalized martingale estimate
mathematical_checks.details: Existing Lemma lem:freedman provides the bracket-dependent bound by dyadic peeling. The common probability event explicitly includes the squared-Green martingales at every pole |y|<=3n. In d>=3 their brackets are bounded by C times the energy; in d=2, division by C log n gives bounded increments and the same energy comparison. Young absorption is valid.

mathematical_checks.subject: Planar Green shift
mathematical_checks.details: The shift gamma=(2/pi) log r gives a decreasing majorant [1+|log((1+|v|)/r)|]/(1+|v|); summing over O(r^2) sites costs O(r). Endpoints cost O(log^2 n), and the absorbed residual O(log^3 n) is o(r).

mathematical_checks.subject: Global one-sided potential bound
mathematical_checks.details: Young absorption gives U>=ell/2-C r q at lattice poles; the cell modulus extends this to B(0,2n). Outside that ball, support and volume bound the potential by a constant. The empty-cell contact bound follows by continuity.

mathematical_checks.subject: Backward radial integration
mathematical_checks.details: The derivative of t^(d-2)F(tu) is +(d-2) omega_d/(2 kappa) times t^(d-3) U_E(tu). The lower bound U_E>=-C log n therefore yields the stated upper bound on F after integration backward from 2(b+w). The bounded compactly supported density 1_E/|v| makes F continuously differentiable and continuous; harmonicity away from E and decay at infinity justify both maximum-principle extensions.

mathematical_checks.subject: Cap mass and exterior envelope
mathematical_checks.details: The probe is outside D. For v in the cap, the radial numerator is <=-t and distance <=5t; positive contributions cost C log n in d>=3 and C sqrt(r log n) in d=2. The near/far lemma has w<=b and the required global integral bound. Combining the occupation bound with crossing yields log^(d+1) n in higher dimensions and sqrt(r) log^(5/2) n in the plane.
